offerings.title: Graphic Design
offerings.description: Professional visual design for corporate communications, marketing campaigns, advertising, social media, product promotions and brand materials.

offerings.title: Video Production & Editing
offerings.description: Promotional, company introduction, product and service videos. Projects may use AI-generated content, stock footage, customer-provided footage or a combination, depending on the requirements.

offerings.title: Presentation Design
offerings.description: Business proposals, company profiles, reports, sales presentations, investor pitches, training materials and customer presentations—with clear information hierarchy, visual consistency, readability and professional storytelling.

offerings.title: Print & Marketing Materials
offerings.description: Posters, banners, business cards, brochures, flyers and other marketing or corporate print materials. Print-ready preparation and printing coordination or services can be discussed when requested and operationally available.
